description: Tapline's WebAssembly, run by Wasmtime: a data provider's folds, finalizers and stale-data functions as sandboxed modules, fuel- and memory-bounded on the router; and password sign-in by OPAQUE (RFC 9807), a module of Tapline's authentication in which the password never leaves the client — on the s…

A .NET client's password sign-in to Tapline by OPAQUE (RFC 9807), the password never leaving it: opaque-ke 4 (ristretto255, Argon2id) as WebAssembly, run by Wasmtime — the module Tapline.Wasm's sign-in serves the browser.

Tapline's core and its .NET client: shared state fanned out to many clients, prioritised, conflated and ack-clocked, with ordered messaging beside it; the client's replicas of what it subscribed to, acknowledged frame by frame, resynced and resumed; and MagicOnion (gRPC) to carry it.

A form engine that learns from the records people confirm: suggestions for a form's decided fields from the records already confirmed, what each rests on, and the account of what a person did with them. The .NET host over the Rust engine.

ASP.NET Core endpoints for the Lowline engine: AddLowline and MapLowline put a form's suggestions and saves behind two routes.
